subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is : **more.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The structure of the sentence indicates a comparison of the amount of knowledge between the wealthy and the ordinary people of Egypt.
 
• **"More"** is appropriate for comparisons when the sentence is structured to compare two things directly.

Therefore, the sentence correctly reads: "We know infinitely **more **about the wealthy people of Egypt than we do about the ordinary people."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Most" would typically be used when comparing one subject to a group of others, which is not the case here.
 
• "Much" and "many" do not fit the comparative nature of the sentence.
